home.meta_description: Practise for the Dutch A2 integration exam for free: Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking. 40 practice exams, made by a certified NT2 teacher.
home.hero_badge: Checked by a certified NT2 teacher
home.hero_subheading: Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking. 40 practice exams, built like DUO's. No AI: every question is made by a certified NT2 teacher.
home.skills_heading: Practise every part of the A2 exam
home.skills_subheading: The Dutch integration exam at A2 level has four language parts. Each one has ten practice exams here, with the same structure and timing as the real exam.
home.ai_subheading: Most integration practice platforms generate their tasks with AI — some even state in their own terms that they don't guarantee the content is accurate. We work the other way around.
home.ai_us_1: Every task written or reviewed by a certified NT2 teacher
home.ai_us_2: Weekly review: new tasks only go live once the teacher approves them
home.ai_us_3: Feedback on Writing and Speaking follows the teacher's own marking rubric — she checks the gradings and adjusts the rubric
home.ai_them_1: Tasks generated automatically, with no subject-matter review
home.ai_them_2: Errors and unrepresentative questions stay up for months
home.ai_them_3: Grading done entirely by a model, with no reasoning or oversight
home.social_heading: Tasks made by a certified NT2 teacher
home.social_subheading: Not random questions off the internet — every practice exam is put together and checked by a teacher who teaches integration students every week.
home.teacher_quote: “Learning a language is not just a study process — it is a personal and enriching experience. I want you to pass the exam and actually be able to use the language.”
home.trust_1_text: Every task comes out of daily teaching practice with integration students — and out of the mistakes they make in the real exam.
home.trust_2_text: The same structure, the same number of tasks and the same timing as DUO, so nothing surprises you on exam day.
home.trust_3_text: Practise at home whenever it suits you. You see per part what you are strong at and what still needs work.
home.faq_heading: Frequently asked questions about the A2 integration exam
home.faq_subheading: Everything you need to know before you start practising
home.faq_q1: Which parts does the A2 integration exam have?
home.faq_a1: The exam has four language parts: Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking. You also take KNM (Knowledge of Dutch Society) and ONA. This platform covers the four language parts.
home.faq_q2: How many tasks does each part have?
home.faq_a2: Reading and Listening have 25 multiple-choice questions with three options (A, B or C). Writing has 4 writing tasks and Speaking has 16 speaking tasks.
home.faq_q3: How long do the exams take?
home.faq_a3: Reading takes about 65 minutes, Listening 45 minutes, Writing 40 minutes and Speaking 35 minutes. Our practice exams use the same timings so you know how it feels.
home.faq_q4: How are Writing and Speaking graded?
home.faq_a4: Your answer is graded against the marking rubric our NT2 teacher wrote herself: you get a score per criterion with an explanation. The teacher reviews those gradings and adjusts the rubric where needed. So the rubric comes from a teacher, not from a model.
home.faq_a5: Practice exam 1 of every part is free and complete — not a fragment, but a full exam. You do not need an account for it. All 40 practice exams are available in a paid package.
home.faq_q6: Are the tasks made by AI?
home.faq_a6: No. Every task is written or reviewed by a certified NT2 teacher before it goes live. For Writing and Speaking a model helps apply the rubric, but the rubric, the model answers and the review all come from the teacher.

premium_page.faq_q1: How does it work per module?
premium_page.faq_a1: Every part of the exam is its own module: Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking. You choose which ones you need. A module costs {price} per month and contains the ten practice exams, the lessons and the word list for that part.
premium_page.faq_q2: What does it cost if I want everything?
premium_page.faq_a2: All four modules cost {bundle} per month instead of {list}. So you pay for three modules and the fourth is free. You save {saving} per month.
premium_page.faq_a3: Yes. You cancel whenever you like and it takes effect at the end of the month you have already paid for. There is no set-up fee and no minimum term.
premium_page.faq_q4: Can I add or drop a module later?
premium_page.faq_a4: Yes. You add a module when you need it and drop one you no longer use. If you have all four, the one-free-module discount applies as long as you keep all four.
premium_page.faq_q5: Can I try it for free first?
premium_page.faq_a5: Yes. Practice exam 1 of every part is free and complete, without an account. That way you know exactly what you are buying.
premium_page.faq_q6: How is my writing or speaking task graded?
premium_page.faq_a6: Against the marking rubric our NT2 teacher wrote herself. You get a score per criterion with an explanation and the teacher’s model answer. She reviews the gradings and adjusts the rubric. So the rubric and the model answers come from a teacher.
